ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool for local municipal authorities to detect illegal dumping and unauthorized industrial land usage using computer vision.
ideas.title: EcoAudit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the environmental focus of Plaksha University's AI for Good Hackathon and leverages the pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring to real-world social and environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first AI chatbot providing semi-urban and rural populations with localized health awareness, symptom tracking, and vaccination scheduling.
ideas.title: GramSwasthya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses practical social problems with measurable reach in rural healthcare, following the winning pattern of SAGACITY at the First Prize Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered coordinator that groups nearby senior citizens into social outings and matches them with verified volunteer drivers to combat loneliness and mobility issues.
ideas.title: ElderLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'AI for Good' theme of solving real-world social problems, directly drawing inspiration from the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A walk-to-earn civic engagement app featuring an AI marketing copilot for local community markets and a live dashboard for municipal issue reporting.
ideas.title: CivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a practical, highly demonstrable interface that appeals to judges looking for clear economic and social benefits in local communities.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision inspection system that processes live video feeds to detect structural cracks, obstacles, and maintenance issues in local public infrastructure.
ideas.title: InfraGuard Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves genuinely hard engineering with real-world infrastructure safety utility, matching the pattern of Wabtec's Exceed 3.0 winning project.
